title: No CI runner installs tk, so every real-binary pin skips in CI
body:
internal/tk's TestManifestCommandsAgainstRealTk and the new real-tk re-claim parity test (TestTheFakeTrackerCountsAReclaimTheWayRealTkDoes) both LookPath("tk") and skip when it is absent, and no CI job installs one — the parity against the real binary is exercised only at close-out, on a host that has a tk. The repo solved the same shape for pi (installed into the job whose packages need it, with the pin asserted) and for the cloudflare workspace (node_modules). CI installs of tk would need a buildable ticks ref; alternatively the close-out suite is the declared home for the pin, and that should be said where AGENTS.md describes what CI runs.
evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml installs pi and pnpm workspaces but no tk; internal/tk/tk_real_test.go:26 skips on LookPath failure; internal/reconcile/claim_reclaim_parity_test.go does the same
